name: simota-agent-skills
description: A comprehensive collection of 141 specialist AI agent skills by simota. Covers multi-agent orchestration (nexus, titan, rally), software development (builder, architect, atlas, forge, scaffold), security (breach, crypt, sentinel, guardian, warden), UX/design (canvas, pixel, palette, sketch, vision), data & analytics (gauge, lens, harvest, stratum, schema), content (scribe, quill, prose, lyric, riff), research (researcher, oracle, grok, lore, compass), and many more.
author: simota

security_review.notes: Pure markdown SKILL.md files with references/. Shell scripts in .loops/ only invoke 'claude --print' CLI — no curl|sh, no eval, no remote code execution. Python scripts in _scripts/ do pure file manipulation (os.remove, re.sub, open/write). JS files in harvest/ use execSync for git CLI and puppeteer for PDF — standard tooling. No malicious patterns.
